title: The Sazerac House

services.name: Tours & Tastings
services.desc: Embark on a complimentary, self-guided exploration into New Orleans’ spirited culture and traditions at the historic Sazerac House. Guests of all ages are welcome to explore. Now featuring Sazerac House of Cocktails House Pours. Launching April 16, the Legacy Tour is a new guided experience that takes guests through the rich history of the Sazerac Company and the iconic Sazerac cocktail. The one-hour tour accommodates up to 12 guests and concludes in one of Sazerac House’s private speakeasy bars, The Charente. Tour includes a Sazerac Cocktail, Sazerac de Forge cognac tasting, and a Sazerac Rye Full Proof pour. Experience a guided tasting of exceptional whiskies from Buffalo Trace
